visualCharacteristics: Decade-keyed expand/collapse timeline rows on a grey field, each with a plus/toggle affordance on the right. Rows collapse to a single summary line.
contentPattern: Repeating rows; each row's first cell is the summary label (e.g. a decade) and the second cell is the collapsible body content.
usage: 'BD: A history of innovation' timeline inside the About BD tab on the about-bd-3 template pages.
